title: Tekla Modeler/Staad Pro
description:
We are looking for 5 experienced STAAD Designers to join our dynamic Design & Engineering team. The successful candidates will handle structural design, analysis, and weight estimation of PEB projects using STAAD Pro and related software packages.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Tekla Modeler to join our team in Greater Noida. The ideal candidate will have 5+ years of hands-on experience in structural steel and PEB modeling, with a proven track record of creating highly accurate 3D models.

Responsibilities:
• Software Expertise: Expert-level, hands-on experience with Tekla Structures is mandatory.
• Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of structural steel members, PEB modeling, and complex connections.
• Education: Diploma, ITI, B.Tech, or BE in Civil or Mechanical Engineering is preferred.
• Core Competencies: Strong attention to detail, exceptional accuracy, and excellent communication/coordination skills.

• Structural Analysis: Perform comprehensive structural analysis and design of PEB structures utilizing STAAD Pro.
• Calculations & Reporting: Prepare detailed design calculations and comprehensive structural reports adhering to applicable codes.
• Material Optimization: Conduct precise weight estimation and structural optimization of steel structures to ensure cost-effectiveness.
• Component Design: Design primary and secondary steel members, connections, and support systems.
• Verification: Review, verify, and approve structural drawings and fabrication details.
• Team Collaboration: Coordinate seamlessly with detailing, production, and project teams for smooth execution.
• Compliance: Ensure all designs comply with project specifications, safety requirements, and quality standards.
• Technical Support: Resolve design-related issues during the project execution phase and participate in value engineering activities.

Requirements:
STAAD.Pro / SAP2000, Tekla Structures

title: MEPF Design & BIM
description:
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented MEP Designer to join our engineering team. The candidate will be responsible for preparing MEP layouts, design drawings, BIM models, technical documentation, and coordinated engineering solutions for building and infrastructure projects.

The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of building services, relevant design standards, MEP software, and multidisciplinary coordination workflows.

Responsibilities:
Prepare mechanical, electrical, and plumbing layouts and design drawings as per project requirements.
Develop MEP models and drawings using Revit MEP and AutoCAD.
Work on HVAC, electrical, plumbing, drainage, and fire protection systems, depending on the assigned specialisation.
Prepare coordinated layouts for ducts, cable trays, conduits, pipes, equipment, and other building services.
Develop 3D BIM models and extract 2D drawings, sections, schedules, and documentation.
Coordinate MEP systems with architectural and structural models.
Identify and resolve clashes using Navisworks and other coordination tools.
Review design drawings, specifications, and project requirements.
Support quantity take-offs, equipment schedules, and material calculations where required.
Follow applicable building codes, safety requirements, and project-specific standards.
Coordinate with BIM modellers, design engineers, project coordinators, and other discipline teams.
Maintain model quality, drawing accuracy, and timely project delivery.

Requirements:
Revit MEP and AutoCAD.
Navisworks Manage and Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC).

title: BIM Engineer - Electrical
description:
# Electrical BIM Modeler / BIM Coordinator

**Company:** Tejsheel Private Limited (Tejsheel BIM Studio)
**Job Location:** Pune, Maharashtra
**Employment Type:** Full-Time
**Experience:** 2–5 Years (Preferred)
**Project Type:** US Electrical BIM – LOD 400
**Department:** BIM – Electrical
**Work Mode:** As per company requirements

## About Tejsheel BIM Studio

Tejsheel BIM Studio is a Pune-based BIM consultancy providing Building Information Modelling services across Architectural, Structural, and MEPF disciplines. We deliver coordinated, construction-ready BIM models and documentation for projects in India and international markets.

We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented **Electrical BIM Modeler / BIM Coordinator** to join our team and work on US-based electrical projects. The candidate will be responsible for developing LOD 400 electrical BIM models, coordinating electrical systems with other disciplines, and preparing accurate, installation-ready shop drawings.

## Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain electrical BIM models in Autodesk Revit based on contract drawings, engineering drawings, redlines, markups, feeder matrices, and project specifications.
* Model electrical conduits, conduit racks, cable trays, electrical equipment, hangers, supports, and associated electrical systems.
* Develop coordinated conduit routing and consolidate conduit racks to optimize installation and minimize clashes.
* Perform model coordination and clash detection using Autodesk Navisworks.
* Coordinate electrical systems with Architectural, Structural, Mechanical, Plumbing, and other relevant disciplines.
* Prepare coordinated electrical shop drawings, including:

  * Conduit layout drawings.
  * Conduit rack and hanger layout drawings.
  * Electrical equipment layout drawings.
  * Lighting layout drawings.
  * Penetration drawings.
  * Other electrical installation and coordination drawings.
* Interpret engineering drawings, redlines, markups, and technical specifications independently.
* Identify discrepancies, modelling constraints, and coordination issues and seek clarification when required.
* Maintain model accuracy, drawing quality, and compliance with project requirements.
* Provide daily progress updates and communicate proactively with project stakeholders.
* Respond promptly to project communications through email and Microsoft Teams.
* Meet agreed production schedules, submission deadlines, and quality standards.
* Maintain strict confidentiality and comply with project-specific information security requirements.

Responsibilities:
## Professional Expectations

The selected candidate must demonstrate:

* Ownership of assigned modelling and documentation tasks.
* Proactive communication regarding technical issues and project progress.
* Responsiveness to emails and Microsoft Teams messages.
* Ability to work collaboratively with project teams and meet deadlines.
* Commitment to model quality, drawing accuracy, and coordination standards.
* Professional conduct when handling confidential project information.

## What We Are Looking For

We are seeking a candidate who can independently interpret electrical drawings, develop accurate LOD 400 BIM models, resolve coordination issues, and deliver high-quality electrical shop drawings with minimal supervision.

**Interested candidates:** Please share your updated CV along with details of your Revit, eVolve Electrical, Navisworks, US project, and LOD 400 experience.

Requirements:
## Required Technical Skills

* Strong hands-on experience in Autodesk Revit for electrical BIM modelling.
* Working knowledge of eVolve Electrical.
* Experience with Autodesk Navisworks for model coordination and clash detection.
* Basic understanding of electrical systems, construction practices, and electrical installation documentation.
* Ability to interpret electrical engineering drawings, redlines, markups, and specifications.
* Understanding of conduit routing, cable trays, electrical equipment layouts, and supports.
* Ability to prepare coordinated electrical shop drawings.
* Good problem-solving, coordination, and communication skills.

## Preferred Qualifications

* Diploma or Degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline.
* Experience working on US-based electrical BIM projects.
* Experience with LOD 400 electrical modelling and construction documentation.
* Exposure to data centers, hospitals, commercial buildings, or other mission-critical projects.
* Familiarity with US electrical construction drawings and documentation standards.

## Software and Tools

The following software licenses will be provided by Tejsheel BIM Studio, as required for the project:

* Autodesk Revit / Autodesk AEC Collection.
* Autodesk BIM Collaborate Pro.
* Bluebeam Revu.
* eVolve Electrical.
* Autodesk Navisworks.
